name: Conceptmeister Free - document summarizer and, concepts extractor

ios.desc:
Conceptmeister is a free App for quick text analysis. It will help to grasp the main ideas of the document without reading the whole text, which makes the App a real time saver for students and everyone who has to read a lot but doesn't have enough time for it.  
	
The use is very simple - just take a photo of any text page, load webpage URL or a document from Dropbox, Google Disk or One Drive and get comprehensive concepts and a text summary in one tap.

Please note, Conceptmeister works with English texts only.
	 
Main Features
	 
	  •  Concept Analysis (with the related sentences)
	  • Text Summarization
	  •  Work with images, webpages and documents of different formats
	  •  Dropbox, Google Disk, iCloud and One Drive support
	  •  Adjustable summary length
	  •  Quality filter for better results
	  •  Language recognition


This application is based on text mining and natural language processing technologies provided by Intellexer™.
Learn more at http://www.intellexer.com/
